artboards.title: B · Milk first, record beside it

annotations.text:
Patience · tag 0

Everything except the milk and money is her real record: Jersey, born 4 Jul 2020, 900 lb on 14 Aug, calved 9 Jul 2024 (Vera), three AI services, lactation 1 dried off 6 Aug 2026, lactation 3 fresh the same day. Milk and money are invented.

All three hold the same material — name, breed, age, weight · life timeline · pedigree · offspring · cost and revenue · lactation chart · milk table. They differ in what you see first and how far you scroll. The day-range chips work; hovering a bar gives you the day.

A — Life first

The record reads like a biography: what she has done sits above what she is giving. One column, top to bottom, no hiding.

Tradeoff: the longest scroll of the three. Money and family are a long way down.

B — Milk first

The thing you check daily gets the width; her record sits in a rail beside it, all visible at once, nothing hidden.

Tradeoff: needs a wide screen. On a phone it collapses back into A's order.

C — Folded into tabs

Same fold the rest of the app uses (Animals, Settings, Grazing records). The page stops being long; each subject gets full width. Tabs work — try Life and Money.

Tradeoff: her story is behind a tab, so nothing is seen unless it is asked for.
